**An attack with an explosive drone in the locality of El Capire, [[Apatzingán]] left one [[National Guard (Mexico)|National Guard]] and a police wounded, while they were on reconnaissance rounds in the area. '''Business and economy'''
*American [[airline]] company [[Southwest Airlines]] announces it will [[layoff|lay off]] 1,750 jobs, 15% of its corporate workforce, for [[cost reduction]]. This is the company's first mass layoff since operating in 1971. [https://www.cnbc.com/2025/02/17/southwest-airlines-to-cut-15percent-of-corporate-jobs-in-cost-saving-push.html (CNBC)]
